title: Actor-bound Sora animation tools
status: Native source and tests frozen; no UI/game-process/live test performed
scope: Sora charID1/controller750300, including forms0..6; no Roxas claim

claims.Finding: Constructor receives controller in RCX and Actor in RDX, sets owner+16 and speed+336 tofloat1. Actor embeds the controller at+344, so speed is Actor+680. Logical/resolved IDs initialize to-1.
claims.Limitations: These are runtime Actor fields, not save data. Full model compatibility is not inferred from this constructor alone.

claims.Finding: Advance uses float delta*controllerSpeed to increment frame; handles loop/blend, root motion and gameplay triggers. Zero is not a full actor pause.
claims.Limitations: Rate0 is excluded from the trainer selection. Speed affects gameplay timing and motion-derived displacement; it is not purely cosmetic.

claims.Finding: Motion/resource replacement resets duration/frame/blend/trigger state but does not reset speed+336. Therefore speed ownership is Actor-wide, and a per-motion lease that simply expires would leak the override.
claims.Limitations: Unknown modded writers can change this behavior. Normal motion/resource identity changes are allowed only with a valid fresh supported View and unchanged Actor/model identities.

claims.Finding: Synchronous void fastcall(uint32_t* RCX) callback reads second8-byte operand lowfloat at+8; decodes first operand handle, then its packed Actor field+4, and writes the float unchanged to Actor+680. No meaningful return value.
claims.Limitations: The first decoded object is an Actor handle/object, not a YS script-context struct. Original performs no validation; wrapper always forwards its behavior exactly once.

claims.Finding: Aligned8-byte callback field in16-byte record. Bank1 root at753498 points755370; index107 record has Writer42FCE0, metadataDWORD2, tailDWORD0. Only callback pointer is CAS-swapped.
claims.Limitations: No friendly VM operation name is established. Foreign replacement is preserved; loss of writer observation makes restoration unsafe and ends ownership without field restoration.

claims.Finding: Dispatcher copies two8-byte operands into its stack array and calls the writer synchronously with RCX. Return flag is absent for this record.
claims.Limitations: Wrapper never retains the argument array. Bridge is pinned; unhooking alone does not prove no callback is already in flight.

claims.Finding: Pose submission resolves model through controllerOwnerActor+1968. Model+32 is the model resource object; its vtable and identity are part of the lease. Palette slots+80/+88 swap during pose submission and must not be treated as stable model generation.
claims.Limitations: Model/resource/header guards establish a plausible current engine object, not validation of every recursively referenced bone/IK asset buffer.

claims.Finding: Prototype/RAW duration getters read respective resource+20/+32. Snapshot duration is published only if controller duration matches the supported header. RAW uses resource+36 samplecount; classes are identified by vtables5B4958/5B4A38 and header tags0/1.
claims.Limitations: Readouts are omitted for unknown formats or inconsistent resources. Frame/ID are never written.

claims.Finding: Drive constructs a distinct new Actor via405030→3A7A40→3D5840→3D2DA0→3DA940→3B3200→3C61B0. Native constructor initializes speed1. Direct copies transfer position, motion vector and counters3356/3360; seven reference-transfer helpers do not bulk-copy the controller or speed field.
claims.Limitations: Subsequent native scripts may set a new speed; the trainer does not rebind to the new Actor or claim its final rate must stay1.

claims.Finding: Private SRW lock serializes observation+native original with all trainer speed mutations. Equal-value script writes revoke ownership before the original. Reset verifies script signal, slot/bank validity and fresh Actor ownership under lock before comparing/restoring bits.
claims.Limitations: Arbitrary third-party direct writes that bypass this callback and write identical bits are not detectable. The private lock coordinates this wrapper and trainer writes, not all external modules.

claims.Finding: Lease binds current Actor, status, controller owner, form, scene heap, field/Actor schedulers, all10 room bytes, model/resource/vtable. Normal motion changes survive. Actor/Form/scene loss never dereferences an old Actor for restoration. Model/motion loss can restore the Actor-owned field only when the exact current Actor/scene remain valid.
claims.Limitations: When identity, scene safety or writer observation is uncertain, no restore is attempted; the current field is left to the engine. Exact ABA reuse of all identities between sampled updates is not ruled out.

validation.scope: Fake allocated memory and stub native callback only; actual SRW concurrency, exception unwinding, VirtualProtect/CAS failure injection and lifecycle tests.
